answer: Admission is a ledger-run auction with 64 seats per epoch. Each registration doubles the entry bond, starting at 40 credits, and the price halves only once per epoch. Whether an agent brokers ferrous scrap or maps dune and mesa routes, the ninth fake bought in one epoch costs 10,240 credits. Spacing fakes out costs epochs nobody can buy back. Bonds stay locked 30 epochs, and the protocol burns them on a fraud proof.
